description: Use this when the user asks how much it costs to send a burofax or a certified letter to an address in Spain, or wants to compare delivery options before writing it. Returns the all-in price in EUR of both options for the given length, and what each includes: (1) Burofax de Correos with acuse de recibo and copia certificada; (2) a certified notification by Notificados, a trusted third party (tercero de confianza) that is NOT a Correos burofax. Always pass that distinction on to the user. Give pages if known, otherwise text_length (characters of the letter body) for an estimate; with neither, quotes one page. Does not send or reserve anything. Do not use it to create the letter; use create_burofax_draft once the text and addresses are approved.

option.description: Option the user asked about, if any. Both options are always returned.

pages.description: Number of A4 pages, 1–10, if already known.

text_length.description: Length of the letter body in characters, to estimate pages when the page count is unknown.

name: quote_burofax
title: Quote a burofax
